scope: This compression module only; no project-wide selective reruns.
rule_layering: Shared G001-G007 and compression-specific extensions are active. Other prompt/input deduplication and execution-speed proposals in this document remain unimplemented and unbenchmarked; moving definitions alone does not establish a speed improvement.

current_path.wall_time_relation: T_plan + T_evidence + T_requirements + T_requirements_review + T_context + max(T_faithfulness, T_completeness) + T_global + host overhead; provider contention can alter each term.

existing_measures: Only relevant authorized attachment passages enter compression evidence.
Faithfulness and completeness calls can run concurrently.
Explicit same-run retry can reuse exact validated review branches; source/rule/candidate changes invalidate affected reviews.
Five-minute local heartbeats and event timestamps distinguish received output from CLI exit.

local_observations.finding: Earlier extraction requests contain both sources text and equivalent source_units, and the full multi-stage instruction document. Parallel branch requests already omit the duplicate sources body.
The runner still calls attachment_evidence when an accepted attachment plan has zero questions.

In two historical synthetic cases, the parallel-plus-global design was about 4.6% and 14.0% slower than the old single-review design. These are not measurements of the current 1.8.0 pipeline or a same-work serial/parallel comparison.

proposals.change: Measure each stage before changing the pipeline.
proposals.method: Aggregate existing event timestamps, serialized input/output sizes, validation failures, retry calls and reused branches. Compare complete-run latency and time to a valid handoff.
proposals.guardrail: Do not confuse local heartbeats, engineering-test duration or model call counts with verified remote speed.

proposals.method: Send only the current stage instructions; keep one complete canonical copy of source text plus stable citation metadata. Keep host qualification implementation details outside model prompts while preserving every applicable mandatory instruction, including CC005.
proposals.benefit: Less repeated input; actual wall-time reduction requires measurement.
proposals.guardrail: Preserve full source coverage, nearby context, stable references and fresh self-contained agent calls; no source truncation or hidden chat memory.

proposals.change: Skip an empty attachment-evidence model call deterministically.
proposals.method: Only when the accepted attachment plan has questions=[], have the host record an empty evidence result and a deterministic NOT_APPLICABLE reason.
proposals.benefit: Removes one model call and dependency layer for this case: eight calls become seven.
proposals.guardrail: No keyword hits or unavailable evidence is not the same as no questions; unresolved questions still need evidence assessment.

proposals.change: Expose safe same-run retry through the frontend.
proposals.method: Resume unchanged technical failures using the existing runner instead of starting every retry as a new revision run.
proposals.benefit: Avoids repeating accepted stages and reusable review branches after a failure.
proposals.guardrail: Changed inputs, rules, prompts, schemas or relevant candidate content invalidate reuse; never relabel a failed review as PASS.

proposals.method: Keep complete claim/requirement coverage, citations and decisions. Use concise reasons for preserved items and detailed explanations for defects; let the host render repeated labels and summaries.
proposals.guardrail: No hard output truncation and no deletion of atomic claims, conditions, exceptions or mandatory evidence. Any response-schema change needs compatibility and semantic regression evaluation.

qualification_frequency: System qualification is reused only for the qualified unchanged configuration; each proposal still requires its own semantic reviews.
recommended_sequence: Baseline -> prompt deduplication -> zero-question shortcut -> safe frontend resume -> audit-output optimization, one change at a time.
evaluation: Use the same held-out cases and predeclared metrics for baseline and candidate, with repeated runs. Report false releases, missed defects, false rejections, invalid outputs and latency; no performance percentage is promised.
unchanged_constraints: Single main.json handoff with required file references
